truncated_segments.description: Wrapped body segments the template's body cap left undrawn (archive_card keeps 7, ledger keeps 10, printed and handwritten bodies keep a computed 13-23). They are absent from both the page and logical_order.

regions.description: S11a: laid-out text regions in region_index order. Always written since S11a; absent from earlier sidecars. Every line belongs to exactly one region.

region_index.description: 0..n-1 in reading order: regions sorted by their first line_index.

type.description: The region name its lines carry in line.region.

polygon.description: Pre-rotation box around the region's line text boxes and its drawn furniture (stamp ring, ledger table frame, signature rule, marginal underline), padded by 8 px and mapped through the page rotation; four points clockwise from top-left, integer final-page pixels. Contains every line polygon of the region.

reading_order_index.description: Position of the region in logical_order reading order (0..k-1); null for a region whose lines are all outside logical_order.

line_indices.description: Strictly increasing line_index values of the region's lines.

logical_line_index.description: Index into text.logical_order.split("\n") of the line this segment belongs to; null means drawn but not in page gold; no template emits it since generator s10c-gold-complete-v1 (d4a-realism-v2 used it for stamp words, signature captions and marginal notes).

logical_join.description: How this segment joins the previous segment of the same logical line: "space" (wrapped text, joined with a single space) or "cell" (table cell, joined with " | "); null on the first segment of a logical line and on lines outside logical_order.

occluded.description: True when a stamp ring, overlay stroke, or overlay text box intersects this line's text box (geometric test, not pixel analysis).

region_index.description: S11a: index into the page's regions of the region holding this line; present exactly when the page has regions.

polygon.description: Text bounding box padded by 4 px, mapped through the page rotation; four points clockwise from top-left, integer final-page pixels.

baseline.description: Typographic baseline mapped through the page rotation; points ordered left-to-right in pixel x regardless of the RTL reading direction (Kraken convention).
